Three corrections would make the saved plan reviewable:

1. **High — Outcome and EV contract.** [Plan § Product boundary and decision ownership](C:/Users/Quintin/OneDrive/Documents/ChatGPT/MLB%20Prediction%20Intelligence/ENGINEERING-PLAN.md:11) and [§ Modeling and evaluation](C:/Users/Quintin/OneDrive/Documents/ChatGPT/MLB%20Prediction%20Intelligence/ENGINEERING-PLAN.md:38) define a home-win probability and a two-outcome EV formula, while the ledger retains voids. Specify whether the model predicts official game winner or settlement winner, and how void/no-action probability enters EV and scoring. Do not apply `p × d − 1` to observations where a refund is possible without a stated treatment.

2. **Medium — Weather evidence at T−60.** [Plan § Point-in-time data contract](C:/Users/Quintin/OneDrive/Documents/ChatGPT/MLB%20Prediction%20Intelligence/ENGINEERING-PLAN.md:21) correctly requires a forecast issued by cutoff, but [SOURCES.md, Weather](C:/Users/Quintin/OneDrive/Documents/ChatGPT/MLB%20Prediction%20Intelligence/SOURCES.md:15) groups archived forecast products together. [Open-Meteo says its Historical Forecast API stitches successive runs](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-forecast-api); its Single Runs API preserves a selected run. Name an archived run product and require its issue time and lead time in the first-slice evidence table. The cited weather page alone does not prove a T−60 reconstruction.

3. **Medium — First-slice quote match.** [Plan § One bounded first slice](C:/Users/Quintin/OneDrive/Documents/ChatGPT/MLB%20Prediction%20Intelligence/ENGINEERING-PLAN.md:70) properly gates matching Puerto Rico Action quotes, but should make **failure to prove jurisdiction and Action designation an immediate stop**, before counting the 20-game sample as feasible. [The Odds API historical documentation](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/) describes bookmaker snapshots and warns that historical bookmaker availability starts only when that bookmaker was added; it does not establish Puerto Rico FanDuel Action coverage. The cited [FanDuel rules](https://www.fanduel.com/fanduel-sportsbook-house-rules-pr) are effective July 30, 2026, so sample dates also need that rule version or an archived predecessor.

Historical as-of availability for starters, lineups, bullpen status, roof status, matching odds, provider rights, and actual commercial cost remains unverified; the documents generally label these unknowns honestly.
